item.title: fix(ui): propagate user accent to Talk Mode and widget frames (#128577)
item.summary: fix(ui): propagate user accent to Talk Mode and widget frames (#128577) talk.config forwarded only the operator ui.seamColor, so a user-selected ui.prefs.accent never reached the native Talk overlay; it now wins with the same precedence the Control UI applies (regression test fails pre-fix). The widget-theme observer now explicitly watches the style attribute that carries the inline accent override instead of relying on incidental data-theme re-sets.
